description: Who recently joined the given companies: name, new title, start month, seniority, LinkedIn URL and the employer and title they came from. Use for job-change and hiring signals on an account list. Pay per new hire delivered ($3.20 per 1,000); companies with nobody new are free. Not for people who left (use former employees) and not for job postings.

companyDomains.description: Companies to check, as website domains (acme.com); full URLs are reduced to the domain

jobTitles.description: Keep only titles containing any of these words

maxChargeUsd.description: Maximum spend for this call in USD (default 5); the run stops at the cap and rows already delivered are the only ones charged

maxPerCompany.description: At most this many people per company (default 50)

since.description: Exact start month or date (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD); wins over sinceMonths

sinceMonths.description: How far back a start date counts as new (default 6)

name: find_new_hires
title: New hires at a company, with their previous employer
